about: The numbers a character can have (docs/design/12-phone.md). Shared by the server, which keeps who has which number and runs the calls, and the game (src/game/phone/), which draws the Danh bạ. A contact whose id is an NPC's (npcs.json) is that NPC: they give their number to whoever has talked to them face to face, and a call runs their dialogue from the graph's "call" node. A contact with no NPC on the island (Má) has its own name, role and dialogue, and is given at the start to characters whose archetype has a tag in start_for. Every contact's dialogue must have a call node. Texts (quests.json, "texts") may come from any contact, and the sender's number is kept when one arrives.
